SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is population distribution useful to county planners? (1 mark)
   A. It helps them to grow tea
   B. It helps them to change the weather
   C. It helps them to move rivers
   D. It helps them to place schools, clinics and roads where people live

2. What is a peace corner? (1 mark)
   A. A shop
   B. A quiet place to calm down or talk through a problem
   C. A place to hide
   D. A place to fight

3. What is a mountain? (1 mark)
   A. A wide flat area
   B. A large body of water
   C. Very high land with steep sides and a peak
   D. A low place between hills

4. Which country lies to the south of Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Ethiopia
   B. Uganda
   C. Tanzania
   D. South Sudan

5. Which food is made of maize and beans mixed together? (1 mark)
   A. Mahamri
   B. Chapati
   C. Pilau
   D. Githeri

6. During the dry season herders in dry areas often do what? (1 mark)
   A. Sell umbrellas
   B. Plant maize
   C. Move animals to find water and grass
   D. Collect rainwater

7. How is money useful in trade? (1 mark)
   A. It makes buying and selling easier
   B. It stops trade
   C. It builds houses
   D. It grows crops

8. Which of these shows interdependence? (1 mark)
   A. A woman sleeping
   B. A child eating alone
   C. Farmer sells maize and buys clothes from a tailor
   D. A man refusing help

9. What is an artefact? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A river
   C. An object made and used by people in the past
   D. A type of weather

10. Which is not a good reason to choose a project? (1 mark)
   A. It is dangerous but exciting
   B. We have the skills
   C. It is wanted
   D. It is safe

11. In an election, 12 pupils voted for Amina and 10 for Brian. Who wins? (1 mark)
   A. Both
   B. Nobody
   C. Brian
   D. Amina

12. What is the history of a school? (1 mark)
   A. The school timetable
   B. The school bell
   C. The school menu
   D. The story of how it started and changed

13. Which symbol on a weather chart shows rain? (1 mark)
   A. A yellow sun
   B. A thermometer
   C. A cloud with lines falling from it
   D. A plain cloud

14. Why do schools have rules? (1 mark)
   A. To keep everyone safe and help learning
   B. To stop friendship
   C. To stop lessons
   D. To make pupils sad

15. What is profit? (1 mark)
   A. Money left after paying all costs
   B. All the money spent
   C. The price of a book
   D. Money borrowed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State three causes of child abuse in a community. (3 marks)

17. Explain what a child should do if someone makes them feel unsafe. (3 marks)

18. Explain three rules of good digital citizenship. (3 marks)

19. Give three examples of artefacts and say how each is used. (3 marks)

20. Give three questions to ask when choosing a school enterprise project. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — It helps them to place schools, clinics and roads where people live
   Services should reach people where they live.

2. B — A quiet place to calm down or talk through a problem
   A peace corner helps pupils settle problems.

3. C — Very high land with steep sides and a peak
   A mountain is much higher than the land around it.

4. C — Tanzania
   Tanzania borders Kenya to the south.

5. D — Githeri
   Githeri is maize and beans.

6. C — Move animals to find water and grass
   Grass and water become scarce, so herders move.

7. A — It makes buying and selling easier
   Money is a common way of paying for goods and services.

8. C — Farmer sells maize and buys clothes from a tailor
   The farmer and tailor depend on each other.

9. C — An object made and used by people in the past
   Artefacts include tools, pots and clothes.

10. A — It is dangerous but exciting
   A project must be safe for children.

11. D — Amina
   12 is more than 10.

12. D — The story of how it started and changed
   History tells how the school began and grew.

13. C — A cloud with lines falling from it
   Falling lines under a cloud show rain.

14. A — To keep everyone safe and help learning
   Rules protect people and help learning.

15. A — Money left after paying all costs
   Profit = income - costs.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Poverty, harmful beliefs and lack of knowledge of the law. Accept greed or conflict.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each cause.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, go to a safe place, and tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask an adult before going online, do not share private information, and be kind and never bully online.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: A clay pot for cooking or storing water, a basket for carrying items, and a stool for sitting. Accept other correct examples.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct artefact with use.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do people want it? Do we have the materials and skills? Is it safe? Can we earn more than we spend?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible question.
